text:
### Proof of Address (Choose One)  
✓ **Utility Bill**
- Must be dated within 3 months
- Must show customer name and address
- Copy and file  
✓ **Council Tax Letter**
- Must be current year
- Must show customer name and address
- Copy and file  
✓ **Bank Statement**
- Must be dated within 3 months
- Must show customer name and address
- Copy and file  
❌ **Not Acceptable:**
- Expired documents
- P45/P60 tax documents
- Tenancy agreements
- Mobile phone bills

raw_entities.description: The Know Your Customer address verification process requiring customers to provide one of three acceptable document types: utility bill, council tax letter, or bank statement. Each document must meet specific dating and information requirements and must be copied and filed.

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Document Acceptance Requirement
raw_entities.description: The compliance obligation to accept only specific document types as proof of address during KYC verification: utility bills, council tax letters, or bank statements. All other document types including expired documents, P45/P60 tax documents, tenancy agreements, and mobile phone bills must be rejected.
context: Not Acceptable: Expired documents, P45/P60 tax documents, Tenancy agreements, Mobile phone bills

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Document Filing Requirement
raw_entities.description: The compliance obligation to copy and file all acceptable proof of address documents as part of the KYC verification process.
